name: Malindi Reihana-Ruka
story: Malindi Reihana-Ruka appears in an undated Women in Spatial + Surveying committee biography as the organisation’s student representative while studying for a Bachelor of Surveying at the University of Otago. She described an interest in using surveying and spatial skills in work with her own community and in environmental protection. The profile records her intention to promote events and encourage women entering the profession. Because the committee page is undated, this account does not describe her present study or employment status.
